subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a core session-level `process.*` / `step.*` event contract, and what authorization, replay, and redaction guarantees should it have?
rationale: The implementation would define a new core gateway/session event contract and expose intermediate run state, so automation should not choose the taxonomy or security boundary on its own.

options.title: Approve a narrow additive contract
options.body: Design process/step events as a versioned, additive gateway/session contract backed by explicit scoping, redaction, replay, and compatibility tests.

options.title: Reuse existing activity streams
options.body: Keep `agent`, `item`, `tool`, `lifecycle`, and `session.tool` as the supported progress surfaces and document how clients should consume them instead.

options.title: Defer to narrower issue work
options.body: Leave this broad contract open until related progress/UI/CLI issues prove which common process model is needed.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow additive contract
recommendation.body: Design process/step events as a versioned, additive gateway/session contract backed by explicit scoping, redaction, replay, and compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history points to current agent event and gateway routing ownership in the central files that would define the contract.
